title: BookIndex (Zalizniakiada): an interactive reference and corpus laboratory for the scholarly legacy of A. A. Zaliznyak
description:
BookIndex is a self-contained, offline-capable web reference and digital-humanities workspace built around the books and public lectures of the Russian linguist A. A. Zaliznyak (1935-2017): a corpus index (names, toponyms, ethnonyms, languages, lexicon and subject terms), a KWIC concordance, network and geospatial visualisations, a timecoded transcript corpus of the lecture videos, and Linked Open Data alignment (Glottolog, WALS, Wikidata, Starling).

The software is licensed under Apache-2.0 and the compiled index data under CC BY 4.0. Quoted excerpts and full-text lecture transcripts from Zaliznyak's books and lectures are cited with permission of the rights holders and are not covered by CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
